core_values: The nation and its people come first
Preservation of cultural identity and traditional way of life
Secure borders and strict immigration control
Opposition to globalist elites and unaccountable institutions
Direct democracy and the will of ordinary citizens

economic_policy.taxation: Low taxes on working families and domestic businesses; punitive tariffs on foreign imports; windfall taxes on multinational corporations that offshore jobs; oppose international tax agreements.
economic_policy.trade: Economic nationalism; high protective tariffs; withdraw from multilateral trade organisations; buy-domestic procurement mandates; renegotiate all trade deals that harm domestic workers.
economic_policy.regulation: Deregulate domestic small business; heavily regulate foreign-owned companies operating domestically; oppose international regulatory standards imposed from outside; protect domestic agriculture.

social_policy.healthcare: Healthcare priority for citizens and legal residents only; oppose taxpayer-funded healthcare for illegal immigrants; domestic pharmaceutical production; withdraw from global health governance.
social_policy.education: National history, patriotic values, and civic duty as core curriculum; oppose multicultural and progressive ideology in schools; promote vocational training and apprenticeships; parents' rights over curriculum.
social_policy.housing: Citizens-first housing allocation; ban foreign ownership of residential property; crack down on immigration-driven housing pressure; support homeownership for working families.
social_policy.civil_rights: Equality under national law for all citizens; oppose international human-rights bodies overriding domestic legislation; protect freedom of speech against political correctness; defend traditional social values.
social_policy.immigration: Dramatic reduction in all immigration; immediate deportation of illegal entrants; end birthright citizenship loopholes; strict cultural assimilation requirements; moratorium on immigration from incompatible cultures.

governance.decentralization: Strong central government on sovereignty, defence, and borders; binding national referenda on major issues; break the power of unelected bureaucrats and technocrats.
governance.transparency: Ban foreign funding of domestic political organisations; full financial disclosure for all officials; restrict dual citizens from sensitive government positions; anti-corruption crackdown.
governance.electoral_reform: Strict voter ID with proof of citizenship; oppose mail-in voting expansion; citizens-only voting; recall elections for politicians who betray campaign promises.

environment.climate_action: National interests over international climate commitments; reject binding emissions targets imposed by global bodies; clean energy only when it creates domestic jobs and doesn't raise costs for families.
environment.energy: Full energy independence through all domestic resources including fossil fuels and nuclear; strategic energy reserves; oppose energy dependence on any foreign nation; support domestic energy workers.
environment.conservation: Protect national landscapes as cultural heritage; oppose foreign-funded environmental campaigns that restrict domestic economic activity; practical conservation led by local communities, not international NGOs.

security.defense: Military strength as non-negotiable; expand armed forces; modernise defence industry domestically; mandatory national service consideration; defend the homeland first.
security.law_enforcement: Zero tolerance for crime; harsh penalties for violent offenders and drug traffickers; fully fund and expand police; oppose bail reform and soft-on-crime policies; deport foreign criminals immediately.
security.foreign_policy: Sovereignty-first diplomacy; withdraw from international organisations that constrain national action; bilateral alliances based strictly on mutual interest; oppose humanitarian interventionism and nation-building; end foreign aid.
